statement: Nvidia disclosed that Anthropic's contracted value for cloud services running on Nvidia AI infrastructure has exceeded $180 billion, with Anthropic securing 2.5GW of Nvidia capacity for delivery by 2028.
why: A contracted book of this size tied to one lab is a large, dated forward claim on Nvidia capacity and underpins multi-year merchant-GPU shipment expectations.

impact.mechanism: Contracted cloud-compute value on Nvidia infrastructure converts into accelerator, memory and data-center capacity orders as the gigawatts are delivered.

evidence.excerpt: Anthropic's contracted value for cloud services utilizing Nvidia's AI infrastructure has exceeded '$180 billion.'

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet describing roadshow remarks; no filing text cited for the aggregate figure.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 279.0 -> 180.0 (tol 1%); sources: GuruFocus
